text:
Anya: Quick sync — Vaults Inc wants a coordinated marketplace + SSO/SCIM + HSM/KMS launch. Can we do a short run-through now?
Sam: Ican hop on in 8. What's the primary risk we need to clear?
Priya: Need legal signoff on fallback key wording, plus confirmation of partner attestation format.
Derek: Technical ask from Vaults: exact SCIM attribute mapping and group handling. Il'l draft and send to them.
Kevin: Marketing needs 2 console flows: marketplace purchase flow and in-console onboarding with key binding. Also a 40-60 word partner blurb.
Vaults Inc (partner-bot): Partner uploaded draft attestation and keywrap spec: https://partners.vaults.example.com/artifacts/attestation-2026-04-07.json
Legal: I'll review the attestation + fallback language. Share the contract link and embargo window.
Anya: Embargo proposal: internal freeze Thu 18:00 PT, public lift Mon 09:00 PT. Does that work?
Kevin: That gives marketing time for screenshots. Thumbs-up.
Sam: SP metadata: use prod metadata URL but set ACS index=1 for test fallback. I'll post the XML to the shared drive in 10.
Derek: SCIM mapping (v2, draft):
```
user.externalId <- externalId
user.primaryEmail <- userName
user.name.given <- name.givenName
user.name.family <- name.familyName
memberships <- groups
```
Sending to Vaults with note about optional phone/address attributes.
Priya: SAML smoke tests we want: IdP-initiated login, SP-initiated logout, and attribute preview. Add to the checklist.
Sam: Ops acceptance checklist (will add to playbook):
- SCIM full sync (sample 150 users, 3 groups)
- SAML login x10 concurrent sessions
- HSM keywrap/unwrap + attestation verification
- Marketplace end-to-end buy + bind key flow
- Perf soak at 75TPS for 10m
Derek: Cert/key rotation runbook snippet (for oncall):
```
1) curl -sS https://secrets.re/redwood/vaults/attest.json -o /tmp/attest.json
2) ./ops/rotate_hsm_keys.sh --partner=vaults --dry-run
3) post run id to #eng-oncall with results
```
Priya: Fallback behavior: runtime prefers partner KMS; if unreachable, fall back to encrypted local key with HSM-wrapped master. Legal wants the phrasing to avoid implying SLA. Proposed phrasing: "Automatic KMS failover to locally-wrapped keys for continuity."
Legal: I'll tweak the wording to be contract-safe and return by EOD tomorrow.
Kevin: I'll draft the marketplace blurb with the fallback note and two screenshots (purchase + bind) by Thu EOD.
Vaults Inc (partner-bot): Partner can deliver HSM attestation and keywrap sample by Wed AM. Also confirms marketing assets visibility window.
Anya: Owners: Sam (integration metadata + tests), Derek (SCIM + runbook), Priya (technical doc + fallback wording), Kevin (marketing + PR), Legal (contract + fallback language). I'll assemble the playbook and share a doc link here when ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: Uploading SP metadata now.
_notes: Thread captures coordination for a joint marketplace + security integrations launch (SSO/SAML, SCIM, KMS/HSM).
